purpose: Exploratory frequency control for existing confidence >=0.4 Jev arm. No new Jev calls.
policy: At each eligible hybrid turn independently change with q, uniformly among non-base shortlist candidates; otherwise use base. Same top-3 noise and engine search as existing runs.
primary_comparisons: sparse random vs existing Jev confidence >=0.4
sparse random vs existing unrestricted random
analysis: Mean score difference paired by opening; resample complete color-swapped opening pairs. Report intervention rates and uncertainty.
limitations: Reuses examined openings and one seed schedule; diagnostic, not confirmatory.
Matches expected changes per eligible turn, not exact counts or game states.
Calibrated from the already observed Jev arm; do not retune q after seeing results.
